full_judgment: 5. On appeal, the learned Subordinate Judge found that although the oral gift of Asimon Bibi, the recorded tenant, in favour of the plaintiff No. 1 was not proved but his possession to the extant of half of 0.46 acres in Plot No. 1121 within Khatian No. 105 (Ext. 3) was found to be recorded. The learned Judge found that the permissive possession of the plaintiff No. 1 to the extent of 0.23 acres of land was never withdrawn either by Erfan Ali or the present defendants. He also found that the alleged Nadia was never acted upon. With these findings, the Appellate Court affirmed the judgment and decree passed by the Trial Court.
